places.name: Leuven Town Hall (Gothic Masterpiece)
places.ai_summary: Leuven Town Hall is a stunning example of Gothic architecture, adorned with intricate sculptures and spires. It is one of the most iconic landmarks in Leuven.

opening_hours.notes: Guided tours available at specific times.

places.place_tip: Join a guided tour to learn about the history and architecture.

places.name: Old Market Square (Longest Bar in the World)
places.ai_summary: Old Market Square is a vibrant area in Leuven, known as the 'Longest Bar in the World' due to its numerous cafes and bars. It is a popular spot for nightlife and social gatherings.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the evening for a lively atmosphere.

places.place_tip: Try the local beers at one of the many bars.

places.name: University Library & Tower
places.ai_summary: The University Library & Tower is an iconic symbol of Leuven, offering panoramic views of the city from its tower. The library itself is a beautiful example of neo-Gothic architecture.

opening_hours.notes: Tower access may close earlier in winter months.

places.place_tip: Climb the tower for the best views of Leuven.

attribution.title: Boekentoren UGent Febr2021
attribution.author: Michiel Hendryckx
attribution.description: Bibliotheek UGent, net na het voltooien van de restauratie, maart 2021.

places.name: Great Beguinage (UNESCO Site)
places.ai_summary: The Great Beguinage is a historic complex of buildings and gardens, once home to a community of Beguines. It is a UNESCO World Heritage site and offers a peaceful retreat in the city.

opening_hours.notes: Access to some areas may be restricted during religious services.

places.place_tip: Explore the gardens and enjoy the tranquility.

places.name: St. Peter’s Church
places.ai_summary: St. Peter’s Church is a magnificent example of Gothic architecture, known for its impressive altar and beautiful stained glass windows. It is one of the main churches in Leuven.

opening_hours.notes: Guided tours available, check schedule.

places.place_tip: Don't miss the stunning altarpiece and the crypt.

attribution.title: St. Peter's Church, Leuven (DSCF0898)
attribution.author: Trougnouf (Benoit Brummer)
attribution.description: This place is a UNESCO World Heritage Site, listed as Belfries of Belgium and France.

places.name: M-Museum Leuven
places.ai_summary: M-Museum Leuven is a contemporary art museum, showcasing works from the 20th and 21st centuries. The museum itself is a modern architectural marvel.

opening_hours.notes: Free admission on the first Sunday of the month.

places.place_tip: Check out the museum shop for unique art books and gifts.

attribution.title: St. Peter's Church, Leuven (DSCF0898)
attribution.author: Trougnouf (Benoit Brummer)
attribution.description: This place is a UNESCO World Heritage Site, listed as Belfries of Belgium and France.

places.name: Botanical Garden (Kruidtuin)
places.ai_summary: The Botanical Garden, also known as Kruidtuin, is a beautiful and serene garden in the heart of Leuven. It features a wide variety of plants and flowers, and is a great place for a leisurely stroll.

opening_hours.notes: Closed in case of heavy rain or storms.

places.best_time_to_visit: Spring and summer for blooming flowers
places.place_tip: Visit the palm house for a tropical experience.

attribution.description: Meise (Belgium), National Garden of Belgium - Balat Greenhouse (1854).

places.name: Arenberg Castle
places.ai_summary: Arenberg Castle is a historic castle located in the outskirts of Leuven. It features beautiful gardens and a moat, and is a great example of medieval architecture.

opening_hours.notes: Last entry 30 minutes before closing.

places.place_tip: Explore the gardens and the castle interior.

attribution.title: Castle Arenberg, Katholieke Universiteit Leuven adj
attribution.author: Juhanson
attribution.description: Castle Arenberg, part of the Katholieke Universiteit Leuven, Belgium.

places.name: Oude Markt Nightlife
places.ai_summary: Oude Markt is famous for its vibrant nightlife, with numerous bars and cafes lining the square. It's a popular gathering spot for locals and tourists alike.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the evening for a lively atmosphere.

places.place_tip: Visit multiple bars to experience the local beer culture.

places.name: Ladeuzeplein Square
places.ai_summary: Ladeuzeplein is a large square in Leuven, known for its impressive library and vibrant atmosphere. It's a great place to relax and people-watch.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during the day for a lively atmosphere.

places.place_tip: Check out the nearby shops and cafes.

places.name: Stella Artois Brewery Tour
places.ai_summary: The Stella Artois Brewery Tour offers a fascinating insight into the brewing process of one of the world's most famous beers. The tour includes a visit to the historic brewery and a beer tasting session.

opening_hours.notes: Advance booking recommended, especially on weekends.

places.place_tip: Don't miss the beer tasting session at the end of the tour.

attribution.description: Stella Artois chalice as served in pubs and restaurants

places.name: Naamsestraat Architecture
places.ai_summary: Naamsestraat is famous for its stunning architecture, featuring a mix of Gothic, Renaissance, and modern buildings. It's a great street to explore on foot.

opening_hours.notes: Best explored on foot to appreciate the architecture.

places.place_tip: Take your time to explore the details of the buildings.

attribution.title: Universiteitshal K.U.Leuven
attribution.author: Frie Van Grunderbeeck
attribution.description: University Hall, University of Leuven, Naamsestraat 22 - Belgium

places.name: Park Abbey
places.ai_summary: Park Abbey is a former abbey located in a beautiful park area. It features historic buildings, a church, and lovely gardens. It's a peaceful place to visit and relax.

opening_hours.notes: Check the website for special events and closures.

places.best_time_to_visit: Spring and summer for garden blooms
places.place_tip: Visit the church and take a walk in the park.

places.name: Leuven City Park
places.ai_summary: Leuven City Park is a large public park in the city center, perfect for a leisurely stroll, a picnic, or simply relaxing. It features beautiful landscaping, ponds, and walking paths.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during the day for a relaxing experience.

places.place_tip: Bring a picnic and enjoy the scenery.

places.name: Fons Sapientiae Fountain
places.ai_summary: The Fons Sapientiae Fountain is a beautiful and historic fountain located in the city center. It is a popular meeting point and a great spot to relax and people-watch.

opening_hours.notes: Best viewed in the morning light.

places.place_tip: Great spot for photography, especially at sunrise.

places.name: Leuven Beer Weekend (Seasonal)
places.ai_summary: Leuven Beer Weekend is a popular annual event celebrating the city's rich beer culture. It features local breweries, beer tastings, and food pairings.

opening_hours.notes: Check the official website for exact dates and details.

places.place_tip: Sample a variety of local beers and enjoy the festive atmosphere.

places.name: Historical City Hall Square View
places.ai_summary: The view of the Historical City Hall Square is breathtaking, especially at sunset. The square is surrounded by stunning Gothic architecture and is a UNESCO World Heritage site.

opening_hours.notes: Best viewed at sunset for a magical experience.

places.place_tip: Bring a camera to capture the stunning architecture.

places.name: Saint Donatus Park
places.ai_summary: Saint Donatus Park is a lovely public park in Leuven, perfect for a relaxing walk or a picnic. It features beautiful landscaping and a pond.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during the day.

places.place_tip: Bring birdseed to feed the ducks at the pond.

places.name: Vaartkom Harbour
places.ai_summary: Vaartkom Harbour is a picturesque harbour area in Leuven, great for a leisurely walk or a bike ride. It features beautiful views of the water and the surrounding buildings.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during the day.

places.place_tip: Enjoy a bike ride along the water.

places.name: Inbev Experience Center
places.ai_summary: The Inbev Experience Center offers an interactive and educational experience about the brewing process and the history of beer in Belgium. It includes tastings and a brewery tour.

opening_hours.notes: Advance booking recommended.

places.place_tip: Participate in the beer tasting session.
